contentType.description: Content-Type response header as received; null if absent.

json.description: Parsed JSON body. Present only when the response body is valid JSON and fits max_content_bytes; can be null if the body is null. Other bodies (Markdown from HTML/PDF, text, invalid or cut JSON) are in content[0].text.

truncated.description: true when the body text in content was cut to max_content_bytes. Absent when not cut.
